title: Al-Hussein Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Replacement is restricted to the independently mapped outline of Al-Hussein Mosque.

terrainReference.basis: Original site terrain on the mosque’s open plaza, south of the historical façade.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap mosque and square, corroborated by matching Overture record.
mapIdentity.scope: The named mosque outline is identical in the native OpenStreetMap and Overture sources. The adjacent Midan Hussein boundary and western pedestrian street identify the forecourt and entry frontage.

note: The two native Qualla photographs and a 2006 full-front photograph anchor the minaret profiles, pointed windows and stone cornice. The restoration authority records the older Green Gate and shrine. The canopy engineer specifies three 256 square metre umbrellas.
